note: Every vault upgrade and vault group the game defines, from game data v29.2.1 (build 1294). levels[i] is level i+1: value is the total benefit at that level as the game stores it, keyCost the keys that level costs. unit is the game's value kind: Percentage100 is already a percent (5 means 5%), Seconds is seconds, None is a plain number shown as stored (0.01 for the Basic coin bonus, 2 for 2 m of bot range, 3 for three presets, 1 for an on/off upgrade). symbol is the sign the game prints before the value; None prints no sign. requirements: Card and CardMastery give a card id (card is the game's name for it); TournamentLeague gives a league id (0 Copper, 1 Silver, 2 Gold, 3 Platinum, 4 Champion, 5 Legend, 6 Mythic) that the highest league reached must be at least. dependsOn is the vaultId of the upgrade this one builds on, null when there is none. description is the game's English text, with {0} standing for value. groups list their upgradeIds in the game's display order; groupId is the game's number for the group. idsWithoutData are upgrade ids the game names but defines no upgrade for.
